outcome: Defects on endoanal ultrasonography (EA USS) (incidence and extent)
cohort: 69 women who had undergone primary repair of 3a obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI) tears and were seen in a tertiary referral perineal clinic between January 2020 and December 2022.
finding: Symptoms of anal incontinence alone are not predictive of underlying anorectal structural compromise, as a significant proportion (38%) of asymptomatic women with 3a OASI tears still exhibited defects on EA USS.
mod_finding: Women who experienced forceps delivery were more likely to be symptomatic with anal incontinence.
